datasheet_identity.title: BZX84C2V4 THRU BZX84C75 SURFACE MOUNT ZENER DIODES

extraction_notes: Family datasheet BZX84C2V4 THRU BZX84C75; all table values are from the BZX84C12 row on p. 2.
Zener voltage limits: VZ min 11.4 V, nom 12 V, max 12.7 V at IZT = 5 mA. breakdown_voltage records the nominal column.
Maximum zener impedance ZZT = 25 ohm at IZT = 5 mA; knee impedance ZZK = 150 ohm at IZK = 1.0 mA (p. 2, BZX84C12 row). The schema has no impedance fields, so these fitting inputs are recorded here.
Typical temperature coefficient at IZTC: +6.0 to +10 mV/degC; admissible zener current IZM = 5 mA (p. 2, BZX84C12 row).

The Fig. 2 curve for the 12 V part is drawn as a near-vertical line at this print resolution; the digitized points reflect that stylized artwork (constant 11.8 V up to about 10 mA with a bend toward 12.3 V near the 300 mW power envelope) and should not be used to infer zener impedance in preference to the tabulated ZZT/ZZK.

Figs. 3-6 (temperature coefficient, leakage, capacitance, dynamic impedance) plot family-wide values against nominal zener voltage, not per-part characteristics, and were not extracted as curves; no per-part capacitance table value exists, so capacitance is null.
